situation: Placing caches relative to edge data sources in a K8s/K3s estate.
decision: Run K3s caches close to edge data sources, serve fresh local results there, and asynchronously promote reusable results into the regional Kubernetes cache.
reasoning_physics: Cache reuse is geometric in distance: serving locally avoids WAN latency and egress cost; promotion happens async so the fast path never blocks on regional sync. Edge-hit-first, promote-after.
